block.witherutils.angel.desc: Tired of building towers just to float a block in mid-air? Fair warning: this block is extremely unstable. On the bright side, if it hits you, your Blockhead gets a Feather Buff
block.witherutils.anvil.desc: A cursed anvil that can be used to create new items. Place an original anvil and use a hammer with your right mouse button. But be careful, it might get a bit shaky. To use the anvil, place an item on it and right-click with a Hammer. After a few hits, you may get a new item.
block.witherutils.bricks_dark.desc: Heavy-duty dark industrial bricks for the style-conscious BlockHead. Blast-resistant, grim, and guaranteed to make your factory look 200% more intimidating.
block.witherutils.bricks_lava.desc: Infused with molten magma for that cozy industrial glow. Watch your step—walking on these without sneaking will singe your BlockHead toes, and rain will temporarily cool them down.
block.witherutils.catwalk.desc: Industrial steel catwalk platform with grated flooring. Safely build walkways across high gaps, dampens fall impact, and snaps forward when placing.
block.witherutils.creative_generator.des: Creative Handler Block for develop testing.
block.witherutils.floorsensor.desc: Step right up! This smart pressure plate scans the area above it for Players, Hostile Mobs, or Passive Creatures and emits a signal when triggered. Insert any solid block into its ghost slot to camouflage it completely.
block.witherutils.greenhouse.desc: BlockHead Industry's answer to slow photosynthesis. Place these glass panels above your watered farmland where they can see the sky to concentrate sunlight and significantly speed up crop growth underneath.
block.witherutils.rack_case.desc: The structural backbone of BlockHead Industry's high-density storage. Build a hollow 3x3x3 frame out of Rack Cases, place a Controller in the center, and attach a Rack Terminal to the outer wall to form a massive storage multiblock.
block.witherutils.rack_terminal.desc: The access port for your Rack storage structure. Integrate it into the outer wall of a Rack Case frame facing the central Controller to form the multiblock and connect your item or fluid pipes.
block.witherutils.rackfluid_controller.d: The heart of the Fluid Rack multiblock. Place this controller in the center of a 3x3x3 Rack Case frame with a Terminal to store massive amounts of fluids in a single structure.
block.witherutils.rackitem_controller.de: The brain of the Item Rack multiblock. Place this controller in the center of a 3x3x3 Rack Case frame with a Terminal to unlock high-capacity bulk item storage.
block.witherutils.slicedconcrete_black.d: Reinforced industrial concrete with sleek metal grooves. Ideal for clean lab floors, modern bunkers, and heavy machine rooms.
block.witherutils.slicedconcrete_gray.de: Reinforced industrial concrete with sleek metal grooves. Ideal for clean lab floors, modern bunkers, and heavy machine rooms.
block.witherutils.slicedconcrete_white.d: Reinforced industrial concrete with sleek metal grooves. Ideal for clean lab floors, modern bunkers, and heavy machine rooms.
block.witherutils.solar_adv.desc: While the average BlockHead is worrying about climate change, BlockHead Industry brings the latest solar technology directly to your roof. Now also with Alexa support and Red Giant alerts directly to your Smartphone. Generates electricity during the day. Place the solar panels next to each other to form a network. This way, you only need one cable and they are all connected.
block.witherutils.solar_basic.desc: While the average BlockHead is worrying about climate change, BlockHead Industry brings the latest solar technology directly to your roof. Now also with Alexa support and Red Giant alerts directly to your Smartphone. Generates electricity during the day. Place the solar panels next to each other to form a network. This way, you only need one cable and they are all connected.
block.witherutils.solar_case.desc: This Item is required to craft tools or other Items.
block.witherutils.solar_ultra.desc: While the average BlockHead is worrying about climate change, BlockHead Industry brings the latest solar technology directly to your roof. Now also with Alexa support and Red Giant alerts directly to your Smartphone. Generates electricity during the day. Place the solar panels next to each other to form a network. This way, you only need one cable and they are all connected.
block.witherutils.soulfire.desc: An eerie, cursed flame born from lightning and dark steel. Emits a cold blue glow without burning down your base.
block.witherutils.steel_beam.desc: Sturdy industrial steel support pole. Stack them up to build towering streetlights, support beams, or safety structures for your factory.
block.witherutils.steel_pole.desc: Sturdy industrial steel support pole. Stack them up to build towering streetlights, support beams, or safety structures for your factory.
block.witherutils.steel_railing.desc: Because workplace safety regulations finally reached BlockHead Industry. Prevents clumsy BlockHeads from accidentally walking off ledges and catwalks.
block.witherutils.wall_sensor.desc: Personal space is important for every BlockHead. Mount this motion sensor on any wall to detect nearby players and automatically emit a redstone signal—perfect for hands-free doors and secret base entrances.
block.witherutils.withersteel_block.desc: This Item is required to craft tools or other Items.

item.witherutils.hammer.desc: The Hammer is essential for breaking rocks and shaping metal. You'll need it to create more items.
item.witherutils.soulbank_adv.desc: This object is needed to supply tools or machines with electricity or charge. A stronger unit can increase capacity or transmission.
item.witherutils.soulbank_basic.desc: This object is needed to supply tools or machines with electricity or charge. A stronger unit can increase capacity or transmission.

message.witherutils.flesh_golem_limit: You already control an active Fleischgolem!
message.witherutils.ritual.midnight_only: §8[§4!§8] §7Die Geister schweigen... Das Ritual funktioniert nur zur Geisterstunde um Mitternacht.
message.witherutils.shield.rotten.backst: §c»Ouch! I told you your backside was wide open!!«
message.witherutils.shield.rotten.biome1: §d»You'll never make it out alive from «%s»! Everything looks exactly the same!«
message.witherutils.shield.rotten.biome2: §d»«%s»... ugh, this air tastes foul, like fresh grass and non-End stuff!«
message.witherutils.shield.rotten.chatte: §d»Why are we still crawling around like primitive snails?! Just throw a pearl, bam, and you're there!«
§d»Just don't look them in the eyes... hehe... wait, I don't even have eyes anymore!«
§d»If you throw me forward hard enough, maybe we'll both fly through the Void... give it a try!«
§d»Do you have a juicy Ender Pearl in your pocket? No? Why are you even alive then?!«
§d»Teleporting is like sneezing, except you end up somewhere else afterwards. Ever tried it?«
message.witherutils.shield.rotten.enemy_: §d»Hey genius! Turn around! There's a guy sneaking right behind your unprotected back!«
message.witherutils.shield.rotten.hit1: §d»Ouch! Right on my nose! Learn to block properly, you clumsy fool!«
message.witherutils.shield.rotten.hit2: §d»Ha! Missed completely! You'll break your teeth on my rotten plating!«
message.witherutils.shield.rotten.hit3: §d»Clang! Hey, my paint was freshly polished! Well... three hundred years ago!«
message.witherutils.shield.rotten.hit4: §d»Is that all?! My grandmother in the End hits harder than that!«
message.witherutils.shield.rotten.ore.co: §d»Black coal ash in the rock... musty and dusty down here!«
message.witherutils.shield.rotten.ore.de: §d»Ancient debris buried deep in the rock! How did that stuff even survive the heat?!«
message.witherutils.shield.rotten.ore.di: §d»Oooh... something cold and blue is sparkling down there. Glints like the eyes of the Ancients!«
message.witherutils.shield.rotten.ore.go: §d»Shiny yellow in the rock! The pigs in the Nether would fight over this...«
message.witherutils.shield.rotten.ore.ir: §d»Rusty metal in the walls... who needs iron anyway? I'd prefer obsidian!«
message.witherutils.shield.rotten.ore.re: §d»I smell crackling red powder in the walls... don't touch it, it tingles!«
message.witherutils.shield.rotten.water_: §d»EEEEK! Is that WATER?! Get this wet nightmare away from me, it burns, it burns!!«
§d»I smell MOISTURE over there... keep me far away from that terrifying liquid!«
ponder.witherutils.angel.header_subtitle: ╘ BlockHead Industry — Aerostatic Construction & Elevator Manual
ponder.witherutils.angel.step1.text: Right-click in mid-air with empty space ahead. The Angel Block instantly anchors itself in thin air without needing any support blocks or scaffolding!
ponder.witherutils.angel.step1.title: 1. Mid-Air Anchoring
ponder.witherutils.angel.step2.text: Stand beneath an Angel Block (up to 6 blocks below) and press Jump. The kinetic thermal updraft instantly beams you straight up to the top surface!
ponder.witherutils.angel.step2.title: 2. Updraft Jump-Elevator
ponder.witherutils.angel.step3.text: Right-clicking an unsupported Angel Block with an empty hand or standing on it for more than 2.5 seconds will destabilize it, causing it to plummet to the ground as a falling block!
ponder.witherutils.angel.step3.title: 3. Structural Instability
ponder.witherutils.angel.step4.text: If a falling Angel Block bonks a player on the head, it shatters into soft soul fragments and blesses them with Slow Falling (Feather Buff) for a full minute!
ponder.witherutils.angel.step4.title: 4. The Feather Cushion
ponder.witherutils.angel.title: Angel Block: Spatial Scaffold & Updraft
ponder.witherutils.anvil.header_subtitle: ╘ BlockHead Industry — Metallurgy & Kinetic Assembly Manual
ponder.witherutils.anvil.step1.text: Before any advanced alloy can be forged, you must craft the Steel Hammer using 2 Sticks/Rods, 1 Iron Block, and 2 Iron Ingots. The hammer is the kinetic heart of all WitherUtils crafting.
ponder.witherutils.anvil.step1.title: 1. Primary Tool: Steel Hammer
ponder.witherutils.anvil.step2.text: Right-click a Vanilla Anvil (or Cauldron) with your Steel Hammer to strike it down! Cursed lightning surges through the block, igniting a ring of Soul Fire and transforming it into the superheated WitherUtils Anvil!
ponder.witherutils.anvil.step2.title: 2. The Awakening: Smashing Vanilla Anvils
ponder.witherutils.anvil.step3.text: Right-click compatible raw materials (such as Iron Ingots, Withersteel Ingots, Plates, or Bones) directly onto the anvil face. Empty hands can right-click anytime to safely extract the current item.
ponder.witherutils.anvil.step3.title: 3. Loading the Workpiece
ponder.witherutils.anvil.step4.text: Right-click the loaded anvil repeatedly with your Steel Hammer. Each rhythmic strike sparks bright embers, radiates heat, and compresses the atomic structure toward its forged state.
ponder.witherutils.anvil.step4.title: 4. Kinetic Hammer Strikes
ponder.witherutils.anvil.step5.text: Once all required strikes land, your newly forged component pops out: Iron -> Withersteel Nuggets, Ingots -> Plates, Plates -> Gears, and Nuggets -> Rods. The foundation of your entire tech empire!
ponder.witherutils.anvil.step5.title: 5. Heart of Manufacturing
ponder.witherutils.anvil.title: Cursed Anvil Forging
ponder.witherutils.bricks.header_subtitl: ╘ BlockHead Industry — Heavy Refractory Masonry & Magma Dynamics
ponder.witherutils.bricks.step1.text: Dark Bricks provide blast-resistant, heavy structural containment. Perfect for heavy boiler framing, smelter hearths, and industrial foundry foundations.
ponder.witherutils.bricks.step1.title: 1. Heavy Industrial Masonry
ponder.witherutils.bricks.step2.text: Crafted by infusing Dark Bricks with pure lava. Glowing Lava Bricks emit full Light Level 15 and radiant warmth, providing stylish volcanic illumination without relying on torches.
ponder.witherutils.bricks.step2.title: 2. Molten Lava Infusion
ponder.witherutils.bricks.step3.text: Running carelessly across glowing lava bricks will blister your boots with fiery damage! Hold Sneak [Shift] to safely traverse the incandescent surface without singeing your toes.
ponder.witherutils.bricks.step3.title: 3. Hot Floor Hazard
ponder.witherutils.bricks.step4.text: When open to rain, the molten veins violently sizzle and quench into dark dormant stone with billowing steam. Once the storm clears, internal volcanic pressure reheats them back to full glow!
ponder.witherutils.bricks.step4.title: 4. Rain Quenching & Reheating
ponder.witherutils.bricks.title: Industrial Dark & Lava Bricks
ponder.witherutils.catwalk.header_subtit: ╘ BlockHead Industry — Structural Steel & Safe Catwalk Engineering
ponder.witherutils.catwalk.step1.text: Stack Steel Poles to erect load-bearing pillars of any height. Sneak-placing against floors or ceilings anchors heavy foundation feet and reinforced diagonal braces.
ponder.witherutils.catwalk.step1.title: 1. Vertical Support Columns
ponder.witherutils.catwalk.step2.text: Steel Beams span horizontally between pillars. When placed against solid walls, they automatically anchor with heavy industrial wall plates, creating rigid double-T beam bridges.
ponder.witherutils.catwalk.step2.title: 2. Load-Bearing Cross Beams
ponder.witherutils.catwalk.step3.text: Snap Catwalk slabs directly onto beams or poles. Adjacent catwalks automatically connect into a seamless non-slip industrial deck with dynamic outer corner transitions.
ponder.witherutils.catwalk.step3.title: 3. Grated Catwalk Deck
ponder.witherutils.catwalk.step4.text: Right-clicking an existing Catwalk with another Catwalk instantly places it one block forward in your looking direction. Rapidly span across terrifying chasms without crouching or risk of slipping!
ponder.witherutils.catwalk.step4.title: 4. Rapid Forward Bridging
ponder.witherutils.catwalk.step5.text: Catwalk steel grating absorbs 50% of all fall impact damage with metallic spark bursts! Mount Steel Railings along walkway perimeters for a 100% OSHA-compliant facility.
ponder.witherutils.catwalk.step5.title: 5. Shock Absorption & Railings
ponder.witherutils.catwalk.title: Industrial Steel Infrastructure
ponder.witherutils.cutter.header_subtitl: ╘ BlockHead Industry — Portable Stonecutting & CTM Facades
ponder.witherutils.cutter.step1.text: Crafted from WitherSteel ingots and iron. The Cutter is a portable, ultra-compact architectural stonecutter tool that fits directly in your toolbelt.
ponder.witherutils.cutter.step1.title: 1. Handheld Workshop Crafting
ponder.witherutils.cutter.step2.text: Right-click anywhere to open the handheld cutting menu! Insert raw base materials (such as smooth stone, concrete, or deepslate) and select your desired architectural pattern.
ponder.witherutils.cutter.step2.title: 2. Portable Slicing UI
ponder.witherutils.cutter.step3.text: The Cutter dynamically supports all CutterBlocks in the mod—both present and future! As new architectural CTM tiles are registered, the Cutter automatically provides precision slicing recipes.
ponder.witherutils.cutter.step3.title: 3. Dynamic CutterBlock System
ponder.witherutils.cutter.step4.text: Blocks sliced with the Cutter feature seamless Connected Texture Mapping (CTM). Place them into expansive walls and facades to witness automatic border-joining and corner welding!
ponder.witherutils.cutter.step4.title: 4. Connected Texture Facades (CTM)
ponder.witherutils.cutter.title: Handheld Architectural Cutter
ponder.witherutils.doors.header_subtitle: ╘ BlockHead Industry — Reinforced Architectural Doors & Perimeter Security
ponder.witherutils.doors.step1.text: Choose from 5 distinct heavy-duty doors: Cased Vault Door, Hazard-Striped Warning Door, Creeper Blast Door, Heavy Steel Plate Door, and Modern Light Iron Grid Door.
ponder.witherutils.doors.step1.title: 1. Five Industrial Archetypes
ponder.witherutils.doors.step2.text: Industrial doors automatically detect adjacent masonry or metal wall surfaces and deploy a reinforced outer steel casing frame, ensuring a flush and airtight architectural aesthetic.
ponder.witherutils.doors.step2.title: 2. Adaptive Wall Framing
ponder.witherutils.doors.step3.text: Forget finicky levers and wooden buttons! Unlike vanilla iron doors, WitherUtils security doors can be opened smoothly by hand with a simple right-click, or automated via standard redstone signals.
ponder.witherutils.doors.step3.title: 3. Dual-Mode Access: Hand & Redstone
ponder.witherutils.doors.step4.text: Place two doors side-by-side to automatically mirror their hinges into a magnificent grand double portal. Both leaves swing open outward, providing wide clearance for high-traffic corridors.
ponder.witherutils.doors.step4.title: 4. Symmetrical Double Doors
ponder.witherutils.doors.title: Industrial Security Swing Doors
ponder.witherutils.drag_hint: Drag to Rotate • Scroll to Zoom
ponder.witherutils.greenhouse.header_sub: ╘ BlockHead Industry — Solar Concentration & Accelerated Botanical Canopy
ponder.witherutils.greenhouse.step1.text: Place Greenhouse Glass above your farmland. The canopy harnesses natural light to stimulate photosynthetic cycles and dramatically accelerate crop growth without requiring power or fuel.
ponder.witherutils.greenhouse.step2.text: Ensure the Greenhouse blocks have an unobstructed vertical line of sight to the open sky! Any opaque ceilings or obstructions above will block the solar ray concentration and halt growth boosts.
ponder.witherutils.greenhouse.step3.text: Expand the canopy across your entire field! Neighboring Greenhouse blocks automatically form connected structural glass frames with corner support rods, creating an expansive greenhouse dome.
ponder.witherutils.greenhouse.step4.text: Underneath the active greenhouse ceiling, wheat, carrots, potatoes, and other botanical flora mature in record time. Perfect for automated farming complexes and compact sustainable gardens!
ponder.witherutils.greenhouse.title: Greenhouse Crop Canopy
ponder.witherutils.metal_door.header_sub: ╘ BlockHead Industry — Motorized Bulkhead & Hangar Door Engineering
ponder.witherutils.metal_door.step1.text: The Metal Door is an industrial vertical guillotine blast gate. When triggered, its lower half slides down into the floor while the upper half retracts into the ceiling, interlocking heavy teeth into the frame.
ponder.witherutils.metal_door.step2.text: Place Metal Doors side-by-side to construct massive hangar gates up to 8 blocks wide! Adjacent doors automatically synchronize into a continuous seamless bulkhead with left, middle, and right segments.
ponder.witherutils.metal_door.step3.text: Right-clicking any single panel in the chain opens or closes the entire multi-block gate simultaneously! When opened, the passage becomes completely passable with zero collision obstructions.
ponder.witherutils.metal_door.step4.text: Wire redstone directly or mount a Wall Sensor above the portal. The gate opens effortlessly as you approach, allowing smooth passage for players, automated machinery, and transport carts.
ponder.witherutils.metal_door.title: Motorized Bulkhead Blast Door
ponder.witherutils.rack.header_subtitle: ╘ BlockHead Industry — Modular Bulk Storage Multiblock Architecture
ponder.witherutils.rack.step1.text: Construct a hollow 3x3x3 cube using reinforced Rack Cases. The outer shell forms the structural containment shield, leaving the exact center block (1, 1, 1) completely empty.
ponder.witherutils.rack.step1.title: 1. Hollow 3x3x3 Framework
ponder.witherutils.rack.step2.text: Insert exactly ONE Controller into the dead center of the 3x3x3 structure: Item Controller for bulk item stockpiles, Fluid Controller for colossal liquid tanks, or Energy Controller for high-density power banks.
ponder.witherutils.rack.step2.title: 2. Central Core Controller
ponder.witherutils.rack.step3.text: Install at least one Rack Terminal in the center of an exterior wall face, with its screen oriented outward toward the room. The terminal serves as the input, output, and pipe connection hub.
ponder.witherutils.rack.step3.title: 3. Installing the Terminal Port
ponder.witherutils.rack.step4.text: Once all 27 block positions are properly validated, a burst of poof particles signals activation! The Terminal screen lights up, uniting all casing units into a unified quantum multiblock.
ponder.witherutils.rack.step4.title: 4. Structural Formation
ponder.witherutils.rack.step5.text: Connect item or fluid pipes, energy conduits, or right-click the Terminal to manage your bulk storage. Multiple terminals can be added to different faces for high-throughput factory lines!
ponder.witherutils.rack.step5.title: 5. Automation & High-Density Piping
ponder.witherutils.rack.title: High-Density RACK Multiblock
ponder.witherutils.sensor.header_subtitl: ╘ BlockHead Industry — Detection Systems & Camouflage Engineering
ponder.witherutils.sensor.step1.text: The Floor Sensor monitors the airspace above it with customizable entity filtering: Players, Hostile Monsters, or Passive Animals. Emits a strong downward redstone signal when triggered.
ponder.witherutils.sensor.step1.title: 1. Smart Floor Scanning
ponder.witherutils.sensor.step2.text: Right-click the Floor Sensor with any solid full block (such as stone, concrete, or wood) to disguise it completely! It adopts the texture of surrounding flooring. Sneak-right-click with a Wrench to unmask.
ponder.witherutils.sensor.step2.title: 2. Camouflage Disguise
ponder.witherutils.sensor.step3.text: Mount the Wall Sensor on any wall face. It casts an adjustable pyramidal motion detection zone with customizable range, beam width, downward pitch, and horizontal yaw.
ponder.witherutils.sensor.step3.title: 3. Wall Sensor Motion Cone
ponder.witherutils.sensor.step4.text: Walk into the motion cone to trigger automatic hands-free actions: slide open heavy security doors, activate lighting grids, or ring audible chimes and alarms without touching a switch!
ponder.witherutils.sensor.step4.title: 4. Hands-Free Automation
ponder.witherutils.sensor.title: Sensor Automation & Security
ponder.witherutils.shield.step1.text: Crafted from hardened withersteel alloy. Blocks 100% of frontal attacks without durability loss. Slows movement slightly while actively shielding your face from harm.
ponder.witherutils.shield.step1.title: 1. Portable Fortress
ponder.witherutils.shield.step2.text: Hold Right-Click to block, then press & hold Left-Click to charge for 500 ms. Release to sprint-dash forward and unleash an abrupt, bone-shattering frontal ram!
ponder.witherutils.shield.step2.title: 2. Charge & Dash-Bash (500ms)
ponder.witherutils.shield.step3.text: Raise your shield within 350 ms right before an incoming strike hits. Negates all damage and immediately retaliates with a concussive counter-strike!
ponder.witherutils.shield.step3.title: 3. Perfect Counter (Parry)
ponder.witherutils.shield.step4.text: Equip the shield in your Main Hand and click Left-Click (no charge needed). Throws the shield flat like a rotating razor frisbee that slices enemies and returns to your hand!
ponder.witherutils.shield.step4.title: 4. Frisbee-Boomerang (Main Hand)
ponder.witherutils.shield.step5.text: [RMB + LMB Hold] Charge Dash-Bash | [RMB Timing] Counter-Parry | [Main-Hand LMB] Frisbee Throw. Automatic swap-back protection prevents lost items!
ponder.witherutils.shield.step5.title: 5. Combat Controls Summary
ponder.witherutils.shield.title: Steel Shield Combat Tactics
ponder.witherutils.slicedconcrete.header: ╘ BlockHead Industry — Sledgehammer Extraction & Multiface Veneers
Sliced Concrete cannot be crafted at a workbench! Place a standard vanilla Concrete block and smash it with the Steel Hammer to violently shatter it into 8 ultra-thin sliced panels.
Extract slices from Black, Gray, or White vanilla concrete blocks. Each color retains high-contrast metallic groove inlays for sleek industrial and sterile laboratory styling.
As a Multiface panel, Sliced Concrete can be applied to floors, walls, and ceilings alike without consuming a full block volume. Clings flush against any solid masonry or casing.
Fully waterloggable and blast-toughened! Combine Black, Gray, and White panels to design modern cleanrooms, research labs, high-tech server vaults, and subterranean bunker corridors.
ponder.witherutils.slicedconcrete.title: Sliced Concrete Panels
ponder.witherutils.solar.step1.text: While the average BlockHead is worrying about climate change, BlockHead Industry brings the latest solar technology directly to your roof. Now with Alexa support and Red Giant alerts directly to your Smartphone.
ponder.witherutils.solar.step1.title: 1. BlockHead Roof Technology
ponder.witherutils.solar.step2.text: Generates up to %s RF/t during daytime. The high-efficiency photovoltaic surface pulses while converting sunlight into pure electricity.
ponder.witherutils.solar.step2.title: 2. Continuous RF/t Output
ponder.witherutils.solar.step3.text: Power output scales dynamically with the current Sun Angle and requires a clear, unobstructed view of the sky above the panel.
ponder.witherutils.solar.step3.title: 3. Sun Angle & Sky Access
ponder.witherutils.solar.step4.text: Place Solar Panels next to each other to automatically merge their frames into a single shared network (Combined: %s RF/t).
ponder.witherutils.solar.step4.title: 4. Connected Solar Network
ponder.witherutils.solar.step5.text: Tap the network from BELOW! Because all adjacent panels are linked together, you only need a single cable underneath one panel to drain the entire array.
ponder.witherutils.solar.step5.title: 5. Bottom Power Extraction
ponder.witherutils.soulbank.header_subti: ╘ BlockHead Industry — Quantum Soul & Energy Storage Manual
ponder.witherutils.soulbank.step1.text: The hollow SoulBank Case is crafted from WitherSteel plates and iron. It serves as the containment vessel for high-density soul charge.
ponder.witherutils.soulbank.step1.title: 1. SoulBank Casing Foundation
ponder.witherutils.soulbank.step2.text: Upgrade your SoulBank from Basic (Tier 1) to Advanced (Tier 2) and Ultra (Tier 3). Each consecutive tier exponentially multiplies capacity and transfer rate.
ponder.witherutils.soulbank.step2.title: 2. Three Progressive Tiers
ponder.witherutils.soulbank.step3.text: Equipped SoulBanks store vast quantities of raw energy and soul essence, powering high-tier processing tools and automatic generators.
ponder.witherutils.soulbank.step3.title: 3. Soul Energy Condensation
ponder.witherutils.soulbank.step4.text: Insert a SoulBank into any compatible WitherUtils machine or generator slot. Instantly unlocks peak operating speeds and maximum storage capacity!
ponder.witherutils.soulbank.step4.title: 4. Dedicated Machine Slot
ponder.witherutils.soulbank.title: SoulBank Power & Battery Manual
ponder.witherutils.title: WitherUtils 3D Ponder
ponder.witherutils.wrench.header_subtitl: ╘ BlockHead Industry — Block Rotation & Maintenance Manual
ponder.witherutils.wrench.step1.text: Crafted from WitherSteel ingots and rods. The Wrench is your essential multi-tool for manipulating directional blocks, conduits, and precision machinery.
ponder.witherutils.wrench.step1.title: 1. Universal Mechanical Tool
ponder.witherutils.wrench.step2.text: Right-click compatible blocks like Steel Beams, Poles, and Sensors to cycle their facing orientation cleanly without breaking and replacing them.
ponder.witherutils.wrench.step2.title: 2. Block Orientation & Rotation
ponder.witherutils.wrench.step3.text: Sneak-Right-Click disguised Floor Sensors to safely pop off their camouflage facade cover and restore the raw optical sensor surface.
ponder.witherutils.wrench.step3.title: 3. Stripping Camouflage
ponder.witherutils.wrench.step4.text: Shift-Right-Clicking drones, industrial machinery, or casings safely dismantles them and drops their components directly into your inventory.
ponder.witherutils.wrench.step4.title: 4. Diagnostics & Machine Maintenance
ponder.witherutils.wrench.title: Industrial Wrench Engineering
tooltip.witherutils.drone_item.place: Right-click on a block surface to deploy quadcopter
tooltip.witherutils.drone_item.wrench: Shift + Right-click with a Wrench to dismantle and retrieve
tooltip.witherutils.minion_staff.desc1: Hold Right-Click near a corpse to summon
